scope: Isolated compiler-pass research. Maintained src, current state, recovery ledger, and source files were not edited.

diagnostic_control.focus: DIFFER; candidate 1993 bytes vs historical 1992; first mismatch +134 (VA 0x403252), candidate 0xF1 vs original 0xE3 in near JE displacement.

historical_evidence: Original +0x84 near JE targets +0x56d, whose line mapping is the fopen-failure log2file at +1389; the return is at +1413..1418 and the [datafile] fgets begins at +1440.
Candidate equivalent branch targets +0x77b, placing the failure log/return at the tail, over 500 bytes later.
DWARF gives fp, buf[1024], ret, data[1024], filename[1024], ok, i, and depth root-scope locations/lifetimes; nested alert buffers and datafile locals are separately scoped.

The RTL BBRO trace assigns the cold failure block to late block 73 (BBRO key -2, changed to -1000102 and visited trace 16); following tracing places blocks 27 through 78 after the main paths. This is consistent with the candidate tail placement.

hypotheses_and_trials.hypothesis: Positive-success nesting with failure log in else may recover the original early failure block placement.
hypotheses_and_trials.result: Existing isolated probe compiled to the same effective object as baseline: no candidate loader output change; all nine peers retained. See research-20260924-load-character-failure-layout artifacts.

hypotheses_and_trials.hypothesis: RTL BBRO pass output can distinguish whether cold block placement is a candidate compiler layout decision while retaining machine output.
hypotheses_and_trials.result: Confirmed: -fdump-rtl-bbro produced a byte-identical .text section and the strict 9/10 result remained unchanged. The dump shows the failure block as late cold BBRO trace 16.
Compilation rejected this flag: locked GCC reports unrecognized command line option; no object emitted.

blocker: The original instruction/line table proves the historical open-failure block was laid out at +0x56d before the [datafile] parser. Candidate GCC trace formation places the same cold block at the function tail. Rewriting success nesting was output-identical. The pass trace explains candidate placement, but available DWARF and call/data evidence do not identify a source spelling, branch-probability fact, or historical CFG construction that makes GCC select the original placement. Do not continue free-form syntax variations.
